mapper.select: SELECT product_id, member_id, name, FORMAT(price, 0) AS price, category_id, image, create_date, modify_date FROM trade

SELECT t.product_id, t.member_id, m.member_name AS member_name, t.name, FORMAT(t.price, 0) AS price, CASE t.status WHEN 'NEW' THEN '새 상품' WHEN 'NONE' THEN '사용감 없음' WHEN 'LOW' THEN '사용감 적음' WHEN 'HIGH' THEN '사용감 많음' END AS statusName, FORMAT(t.shipping_fee, 0) AS shipping_fee, CASE t.trade_type WHEN 'PERSON' THEN '직거래' WHEN 'PARCEL' THEN '택배' END AS tradeTypeName, t.trade_location, t.category_id, c.category_name AS category_name, t.description, t.image, t.create_date, t.modify_date FROM trade t LEFT JOIN member m ON t.member_id = m.member_id LEFT JOIN category c ON t.category_id = c.category_id WHERE t.product_id = #{product_id};
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trade (member_id, image, name, category_id, status, description, tags, price, shipping_fee, trade_type, quantity) VALUES (member_id_SEQ.NEXTVAL,#{image}, #{name}, #{category_id}, #{status}, #{description}, #{tags}, #{price}, #{shipping_fee}, #{trade_type}, #{quantity})
